title: Field lights
description: field/lights.yaml of the game pack: the maps' point lights of the enhanced lighting (an engine improvement, docs/architecture/render.md). Pixels are the map background's.

pixel.description: The light's centre in background pixels (x, y).

radius.description: Where its light ends, in background pixels.

color.description: Its colour, red, green and blue from 0 to 1 (white when left out).

intensity.description: How much it brightens what it falls on at its centre (0.5 when left out).

kind.description: fire (always lit, stronger at night, flickers), lamp (dusk to dawn) or glow (always lit, pulses; the default).
